problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate cargo space across five distinct shipping routes, each requiring passage through five sequential inspection checkpoints.  
The revenue generated per ton of cargo on each route is as follows:  
* For Route Alpha, revenue is 6.952 per ton  
* For Route Beta, revenue is 19.498 per ton  
* For Route Gamma, revenue is 10.434 per ton  
* For Route Delta, revenue is 12.101 per ton  
* For Route Epsilon, revenue is 9.389 per ton  

The handling duration per ton at each checkpoint is detailed below:  
* For Route Alpha, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.887 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.925 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.345 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.531 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.987 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Beta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.385 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 1.246 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.482 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.816 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 1.902 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Gamma, Checkpoint 1 consumes 1.648 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.769 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.637 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.559 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.724 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Delta, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.956 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.283 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 0.438 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 0.237 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.34 (ton-hours)  
* For Route Epsilon, Checkpoint 1 consumes 0.332 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 2 consumes 0.956 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 3 consumes 1.191 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 4 consumes 1.534 (ton-hours), Checkpoint 5 consumes 0.456 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling duration at each checkpoint is strictly limited:  
* Checkpoint 1’s total available time is 123.705 hours  
* Checkpoint 2’s total available time is 147.47 hours  
* Checkpoint 3’s total available time is 136.362 hours  
* Checkpoint 4’s total available time is 169.753 hours  
* Checkpoint 5’s total available time is 122.055 hours  

Given that the total processing time at each checkpoint—Checkpoint 1 through Checkpoint 5—must remain within its respective time allocation, determine the optimal tonnage to assign to each shipping route so as to maximize overall revenue.
